media.observation: All four panels and explicit units/ticks/legends are readable, with no scientific offset colliding with titles. Loading solid/filled and unloading dashed/open lines use actual saved samples; their close overlap does not mean exact equality. Turning point joins lines only; only7 exact-input pairs remain. Tip and global-Q1 distance coincide so one curve overlays the other. Tiny signed endpoint values, very small load/unload differences and the8.2275micrometre peak distance are not resolved on this full-range scale; exact JSON/17digit table preserved. Labels distinguish weighted q_out, lower-body weak force and unsigned boundary distance. Source text truthfully states four original solves, not a new single cycle solve.

Top panels show20 timeline accepts and region-specific minJ/maxabs Hu; bottom panels show all23 raw accepts with revalidated anchors, original residuals and per-state constraint bounds. Axis tick formatter keeps explicit scientific numbers and avoids offset/title crowding; symlog preserves exact zero and tiny negative constraint residues. Peak positive minJ4.658789e-4 appears near zero on linear J scale; exact table is authoritative. Constraint bound is plotted as original positive magnitude with signed residual; original acceptance uses abs residual, no new gate. Raw and timeline indices have different counts and must not be interchanged. The response does not imply pressure, release, stability, full-model Hu or full-path independent reference.
